title: POST /api/v1/payments 503 and P99 collapse
customerImpact: POST /api/v1/payments completions dropped and P99 rose into seconds; Harbor Market sees HTTP 503. Hikari is not what merchant success is calling about.

events.name: Jordan Voss
events.summary: Merged BAYPAY-CAP41. Started canary image 3.10.0 onto 1 of 3 payment-service tasks in baypay-prod-west / us-west-2. Last healthy image on the board was 3.8.4. Asked for a short soak through Harbor Market evening volume.

events.name: Priya Nair
events.summary: Completions on POST /api/v1/payments looking thin versus 18:45. P99 climbing. 5xx tile no longer boring — 503s showing. Asked for the RED board before a Postgres hunt.
SEV-1: payment-service us-west-2 POST /api/v1/payments 503 and P99 collapse. Creates failing or late. Harbor Market evening volume.
Harbor Market: Avery Chen payment c1404e44-0000-4000-8000-111111111404 returned HTTP 503 after several seconds. Same Idempotency-Key retried; client felt stuck. Authorization window at risk.

events.name: Riley Okonkwo
events.summary: Requested comms-and-impact.txt (gate 1). Asked Jordan not to ship another tag and asked Sam not to bounce db-east or dmgr-east.

events.name: Sam Okada
events.summary: Confirmed no student RDS is attached to this service and leftover ND is not on the merchant path. Will not bounce the database or dmgr-east unless a file shows a wait.

events.summary: Pasted a BayOps draft into the bridge and asked whether we should take the suggested remediation. Riley: evaluate after a written next investigation (gate 5). Do not auto-approve.
